The kernel compiles, passes correctness, and is faster than the reference. Here are the results:

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Compiled | true |
| Correctness | 5/5 trials |
| Runtime (mean) | 2.40 ms |
| Ref runtime (mean) | 3.11 ms |
| Speedup | ~1.3x |

The kernel implements `torch.cumprod(x, dim=1)` for a `(32768, 32768)` BF16 tensor. The design is a tile-parallel prefix product: 256 threads per row with 8 elements per thread per tile (2048-element tiles, 16 tiles per row). A Hillis-Steele inclusive scan in shared memory combines per-thread totals across the block, and a shared-memory carry slot propagates the running product across tiles — all in a single kernel launch with FP32 accumulation and BF16 I/O.
